subject: storytime
title: Possum Magic words
about: Grandma Poss uses bush magic to make little Hush invisible so she is safe from snakes, and the two possums travel across Australia tasting people food to find the magic that makes her seen again. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read it together, with him reading the words he knows.

book.author: Mem Fox
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: An Australian classic about a possum nobody can see and the food that brings her back.
